frames.visible_job: Draws one low three-quarter-view carton with a broad front trapezoid and one short outer-right side plane, leaving the crayon insertion area blank.
frames.instruction: Draw a broad shallow trapezoid for the box front. From its upper-right corner, angle one short line back, drop the outer side edge, and join it to the lower-right corner. Leave the whole area above the front top edge blank for the crayons.

frames.visible_job: Adds exactly five parallel crayon shafts and pointed tips just behind the carton front at slightly varied heights.
frames.instruction: From five separate positions just behind the front top edge, raise exactly five narrow parallel crayon shafts. Close each with two sloping tip edges and a small rounded wax point, varying the heights without changing their shared angle.

frames.step_name: Close the rim and fold the flaps
frames.visible_job: Adds the back rim in visible segments behind the crayons and exactly two small side flaps.
frames.instruction: Connect the back rim only through the visible gaps between the five crayons, stopping every segment at a crayon edge. Fold one small flap outward from each side wall while keeping the front and all five crayon silhouettes unchanged.
adds: back rim and two side flaps
introduces: back rim and two side flaps

frames.visible_job: Adds five dark wrapper bands, one blank front label, two short carton seams, and exactly three small wear nicks.
frames.instruction: Mark a wrapper collar below each crayon tip and place exactly one dark stripe band across each of the five wrapper areas. Center one blank oval label on the box front, place one short vertical seam near each front corner, and add exactly three small uneven wear nicks across the established edges.
adds: blank front label and two seams
introduces: blank front label and two seams

frames.step_name: Set the paper shine and shadow
frames.visible_job: Adds exactly two open-paper wrapper highlights, graphite depth inside the box, and one broken ground shadow.
frames.instruction: Reserve exactly two small white highlight shapes on two different wrappers, shade the visible carton interior lightly, and place one soft broken shadow beneath and just right of the box.

final_step.visible_job: Layers red, orange, golden yellow, teal, blue, warm cream, coral, and cool gray only over established forms.
final_step.instruction: Layer red, orange, golden yellow, teal, and blue over the five established crayons from left to right. Add warm cream and muted coral to the same carton panels, cool gray to the existing shadow, and keep the graphite, blank label, wrapper bands, and both paper highlights visible without adding contours.
